task: Check code smells and bad practices in Web.Client application, then fix them

stories.title: Split non-component exports out of files to fix react-refresh/only-export-components violations
acceptanceCriteria: `npx eslint .` reports zero 'react-refresh/only-export-components' errors for these 5 files

`useTheme` (theme-provider.tsx), `badgeVariants` (badge.tsx), `buttonVariants` (button.tsx), sidebar's non-component export, and `useAdminPage` (admin-page-context.tsx) are moved to dedicated files while all existing call sites (grep confirms: calendar.tsx uses buttonVariants; mode-toggle.tsx and sonner.tsx use useTheme; use-admin-page-config.ts uses useAdminPage) are updated and continue to compile
`npx tsc -b --force --noEmit` passes with 0 errors
`npm run build` succeeds

stories.title: Remove explicit `any` types and unused variables in survey-page.tsx and login-page.tsx
acceptanceCriteria: No `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` errors remain at survey-page.tsx (previously lines 23 and 83) — replaced with real, evidence-based types (from api.ts / Form model), not `unknown` used as an escape hatch
No `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` error remains at login-page.tsx (previously line 33, unused `err` in catch)
`npx eslint .` reports 0 errors for these 2 files
`npx tsc -b --force --noEmit` passes with 0 errors

stories.title: Remove unused catch-block variables in admin-settings-page.tsx
acceptanceCriteria: No `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` errors remain (previously lines 52, 67, 85 — unused `e` in catch blocks)
Error handling behavior is preserved (errors still surfaced to the user via existing toast/error UI, not silently dropped)
`npx eslint .` reports 0 errors for this file

stories.title: Fix TDZ bug and exhaustive-deps warning in dashboard-page.tsx; fix exhaustive-deps warning in use-admin-page-config.ts
acceptanceCriteria: dashboard-page.tsx: `loadForms` is declared (e.g. via useCallback) before the useEffect that calls it, eliminating the 'accessed before declared' correctness bug (previously line 16)

dashboard-page.tsx: the useEffect dependency array correctly includes `loadForms` and `navigate` with no exhaustive-deps warning, and does not introduce an infinite render loop (verified by reading the effect logic)

use-admin-page-config.ts: the 'missing dependency: config' warning is fixed with a real fix (e.g. ref-based latest-value capture), not a blanket dep-array change that would break callers passing custom `deps`

Any remaining unavoidable warning (e.g. the spread-in-deps pattern, which is an intentional caller-controlled API) is suppressed only with a targeted eslint-disable-next-line comment explaining why, not deleted or ignored silently
`npx eslint .` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings for these 2 files
`npx tsc -b --force --noEmit` passes with 0 errors

stories.title: Fix exhaustive-deps warning and review admin-stats-page.tsx (largest page file, 504 lines) for other code smells
acceptanceCriteria: The 'missing dependencies: mode and optionsFor' warning (previously line 176) is fixed with a real fix (useCallback/useMemo stabilization or correct dep inclusion), verified to not cause an infinite re-render loop
`npx eslint .` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings for this file

Any other concrete code smells found during review (e.g. duplicated inline logic, magic strings/numbers, overly large single function) are either fixed if low-risk, or explicitly logged in progress.txt with rationale if deferred
`npx tsc -b --force --noEmit` passes with 0 errors

stories.title: Eliminate duplicated CRUD logic across the 7 admin dictionary pages via a shared hook
acceptanceCriteria: A new shared hook (e.g. src/hooks/use-dictionary-crud.ts) encapsulates the repeated state (list, searchQuery, isFormOpen, editingId, newName), load/openModal/handleDelete/handleSubmit pattern that is near-identical across all 7 pages (confirmed via diff)

All 7 pages are refactored to use the shared hook, removing the duplicated boilerplate while preserving page-specific differences (e.g. admin-departments-page.tsx's extra restore action and admin-disciplines-page.tsx's department-select field)

The TDZ bug where `openModal` is referenced before declaration (previously present in admin-disciplines-page.tsx:61, admin-specialities-page.tsx:50, admin-specializations-page.tsx:68, admin-teachers-page.tsx:55) is eliminated by construction (hook-returned function, not a re-declared local before use)

The react-hooks/set-state-in-effect issue in admin-departments-page.tsx (previously line 39) is eliminated or is verified as an accepted, correctly-annotated fetch-on-mount pattern with no eslint error remaining
The `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` error in admin-disciplines-page.tsx (previously line 120, unused `e`) is eliminated
All 7 pages retain their existing distinguishing behavior (different columns, different icons, different API calls, department-name lookup in admin-disciplines-page.tsx) — no feature regression
`npx eslint .` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings for these 7 files and the new hook file
`npx tsc -b --force --noEmit` passes with 0 errors
`npm run build` succeeds
